item.title: Daily Minute — September 22, 2026
item.description: By making another kingdom which you VALUED, you did not keep ONLY the Kingdom of God in your minds, and thus placed part of your mind OUTSIDE it. What you have made has thus divided your will, and given you a sick mind which MUST be healed. Your vigilance AGAINST this sickness IS the way to heal it. item.title: Lesson 96: “Salvation comes from my One Self.”
item.description: “Salvation comes from my One Self.” Although you are One Self, you experience yourself as two; as both good and evil, loving and hating, mind and body.This sense of being split into opposites induces feelings of acute and constant conflict, and leads to frantic attempts to reconcile the contradictory aspects of this self-perception.You have sought many such solutions, and none of them has worked.
